stops.note: slang for energy or spirit, the most likely source, though the origin of 'jazz' is genuinely unknown
first printed in the Los Angeles Times in April 1912, when pitcher Ben Henderson described his 'jazz ball' that wobbled so no one could hit it
the name of the new New Orleans music by 1915; the Original Dixieland Jass Band made the first jazz record in New York in February 1917

current_meaning: a style of music with African-American roots, marked by improvisation and syncopation
